_description: xhttptunnel Split-HTTP / Meek Streaming Client Configuration

_fields.listen: Local TCP listening address for applications to connect to (e.g. tcp://127.0.0.1:1080)
_fields.server: Remote xhttptunnel server streaming URL (e.g. https://example.com:8443/stream)
_fields.target: Target backend service to connect through the tunnel (e.g. 127.0.0.1:22)
_fields.psk: Pre-shared key / token matching server (aliases: token, auth_token)
_fields.sni: Optional TLS SNI disguise/domain (default: inherited from server URL domain. Required if server URL uses CDN IP)
_fields.host: Optional HTTP Host disguise/domain (default: inherited from server URL domain. Required if server URL uses CDN IP)
_fields.fingerprint: Expected SHA256 hex fingerprint of server certificate (optional certificate pinning; leave empty when behind CDN)
_fields.dump: Dump raw packet hex data in logs for low-level debugging
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
